text:
zoe: Quick heads-up — two scheduled unpin jobs for different rollouts overlap in the same regional pool (eu-hosted). We risk a flip-flop where automation unpins before the SDK rollforward is validated. Proposing a short merge window and an explicit hold on one job.

deploy-bot: [scan] overlapping-tasks: unpin-job-772 (sdk@2.10.0 -> remove pin) scheduled at 3087654400, unpin-job-781 (runtime-rollforward cleanup) scheduled at 3087654460, target=eu-hosted-pool:euwarm. Potential conflict detected.

liam: did both jobs come from separate release tickets? we need the release owners to coordinate, otherwise we'll bounce traffic.

release-coordinator: unpin-job-772 is from SDK release 2.10.0 (ticket REL-2248). unpin-job-781 is automated cleanup after runtime rollforward (automation-id nightly-cleanup). Both targets overlap on euwarm tag. I can cancel or delay one if needed.

rika: what's the proposed approach? hold the automation cleanup until SDK is validated? we don't want manual work unless necessary.

zoe: propose this flow: 1) apply a short hold on the automation unpin (nightly-cleanup) for 1 hour -> prevents automated removal, 2) run targeted canary smoke for SDK 2.10.0 (10m), 3a) if smoke green, allow automation to proceed and then remove hold, 3b) if smoke fails, keep pin and initiate rollback to sdk@2.9.4. Also log change window and notify security.

ops-lead: +1. Automation holds are supported: `/deploy pinlist hold job:unpin-job-772 --reason "merge-window coordination" --ttl 3600` will mark as held. We should also add a revert hook in the runbook.

deploy-bot: action queued: hold scheduled unpin -> id=unpin-job-772, requested_by=zoe, ttl=3600, runbook=/runbooks/unpin-merge-window.md

deploy-bot: [completed] hold applied to unpin-job-772 at 3087654365 by zoe (note: automation will skip job while hold present).

qa-bot: planned smoke steps: 1) canary sample 2000 requests on eu-warm, 2) gen_consistency check (threshold 0.2%), 3) token_latency p95 check (threshold +100ms). Will post results in 15m. Link: https://ci.redwood/internal/runs/cc/9921

liam: make sure to include rollout tags in the smoke (`--tag sdk-2.10.0`) so we don't mix traffic. Also ensure alerting thresholds are on for generation drift.

release-coordinator: I'll update REL-2248 notes and postpone the automation cleanup flag in the release metadata. If hold cleared, we keep automation resume time at 3087657965.

zoe: rollback command (if needed): `/deploy rollback eu-hosted --to sdk@2.9.4 --reason "2.10.0 canary fail"` and to release hold removal: `/deploy pinlist release-hold job:unpin-job-772`. Don't forget runbook step 4: notify customers on status page if hold extends beyond 2h.

deploy-bot: canary smoke started at 3087654405, job_id=smoke-cc-9921

qa-bot: canary results: gen_consistency PASS (sampled diffs 0.05%), token_latency p95 PASS (+48ms), api_surface PASS. details: https://ci.redwood/internal/runs/cc/9921/result

liam: great. recommend we clear the hold and let automation run its course. Also add an audit entry documenting the temporary hold and why.

deploy-bot: action queued: release hold -> id=unpin-job-772, requested_by=liam

deploy-bot: [completed] hold released for unpin-job-772 at 3087654510 by liam (automation will run at next scheduled interval).

release-coordinator: updated REL-2248 and added release-note bullet: "temporary merge window held to validate SDK 2.10.0 canary before automation unpin; hold released after successful smoke."

ops-lead: change-log entry created: change-id=chg-20240712-eu-merge-pin. Notifying sec & compliance.

zoe: thanks everyone. Leaving checklist: [x] hold applied [x] canary smoke green [x] hold released [ ] monitor 2h. If any anomalies hit thresholds, we revert immediately and reopen coordination thread.

deploy-bot: thread closed: monitoring active for 2h (until 3087655310). If rollback required, new thread will be opened.
